receiving and sending

send to all mobile operators with SMS interoperability)

SMS SIM, telco connections and messengers.
• 24 x 7 x 365 operationsGet Instant and Concise Alerts
Do you want to streamline your business messaging, communication, and 
customer relationship management processes? Would you prefer a entry-level appliance for quick and concise alerts, compared to setting up an SMS server from scratch?
Join the ranks of successful corporations leveraging short message (SMS) and 
omnichannel social messengers for simple messaging, communication, customer relationship management, e-commerce, and transactions. Experience the power of quick and concise alerts with SendQuick Alerter, the affordable entry-level appliance designed for companies seeking straightforward alert functionality.
SendQuick Alerter seamlessly works with your firewall, IDS/IDP , antivirus, server 
monitoring software, and more. It comes packed with essential features that effortlessly convert email alert messages from your monitoring and security infrastructure to SMS or social messengers. Stay informed about critical events in your office and data centres with instant and concise information.
Why waste your time and resources setting up an SMS server? At SendQuick, we 
have simplified the process for you. SendQuick Alerter is an out-of-the-box appliance server, delivering the fastest and most economical way to get your SMS server up and running within minutes. No complicated setup or configuration required!
SMS Alerts to Reduce System Downtime 
• Firewall under attack
• Intrusion, virus or malicious attack to IT Infrastructure• Power supply interruption• Designed for entry level and cost-effective usage!

SUPPORTED PLATFORMSCOMPLEMENT YOUR SYSTEMS
SendQuick® Alerter server is ideal for your IT / security infrastructure or datacentre. It will complement your infrastructure system like:
• Router• Intelligent switch• Firewall• Intrusion detection / prevention system• Anti-virus server• Network monitoring systems• Infrastructure monitoring systems• Security monitoring systems• Back-up power management system (UPS)• Cabling management systems• Environment management systems
BENEFITS
• Instant alert on SMS, reducing down-time• SMS is delivered anytime, anywhere (even when you are overseas!)• Get SMS reply from your support team for acknowledgement• Selective SMS alert (with filter) and only the important events• SMS store & forward, with guaranteed delivery (network dependant)• Send multiple SMS for each alert to different people• Support unlimited applications, devices and servers (good ROI)
USERS
• Banks / Insurance / Financial Institutions• Stock Exchange• Stock (Securities) Broking Firms• Government• Asset / Fund Management• Telecoms / Operators• Travel related companies• Hotels and service-based companies• MNCs / Factories• All companies concern with security and system uptime
INTEGRATION WITH SOCIAL MESSENGERS 
SendQuick integrates with existing applications to send messages 
instantly via SMS, email and social messengers:HARDWARE SPECIFICATIONS
